entertainment_venues.name: The London Theatre
entertainment_venues.description: A 985-seat state-of-the-art main Broadway-style theater spanning Decks 5 and 6 forward. Stages grand production shows nightly, featuring acrobatics, musical ensembles, dance troupes, and international guest vocalists.

entertainment_venues.name: Imperial Casino / Le Grand Casino
entertainment_venues.description: A high-limit, expansive casino offering slot machines, electronic poker, table games (blackjack, roulette), daily bingo tournaments, and a dedicated casino bar.

entertainment_venues.name: Carousel Productions at Sea (Carousel Lounge)
entertainment_venues.description: Modern theatrical circus productions developed specifically for the Meraviglia-class ships, incorporating acrobatics, modern dance, dynamic LED effects, and advanced lighting engineering.

entertainment_venues.name: Attic Club
entertainment_venues.description: The ship's primary high-energy nightclub, featuring a late-night bar, resident DJs, state-of-the-art sound and lighting rigs, and a crowded dance floor into the early morning.

entertainment_venues.name: Polar / Arizona Aquapark
entertainment_venues.description: An expansive outdoor water park featuring twisting water slides, splash pads, tipping water buckets, and interactive play zones for children and families.
